conviction_note: No consensus exists and no Q3 number is visible before the 16:00 JST release, so the only bar is the company's own July guide, which halved full-year sales and swung to an operating loss. Arithmetic on that guide cuts both ways: the implied H2 gross margin (11%) looks conservative, but the implied H2 parts/repair sales (+65% on H1) look stretched. The findings net to 0. The scaled number is slightly negative (p_up 48 on an 8.5% scale) because this name sold 6 of its last 7 prints and was already falling 5% on the morning of the print. Both measurements are near zero, so there is no real gap to explain.
bar: Company FY2026/11 revised consolidated guide of 2026-07-15: sales 3,179m yen, operating profit -276m, ordinary -285m, net -195m. With H1 actuals (sales 2,126m, OP -23.6m) this implies H2 sales 1,053m and H2 OP -253m. Sources: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260710591466.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593417.pdf. No analyst consensus: kabuyoho shows consensus '--' (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=280A) and no 四季報/IFIS figure was reachable. The bar is the company's guide alone, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register (baseline, as of 2026-10-14, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html): 1.28%, one disclosed seller, down from 1.37%, so slight covering. Margin ratio (信用倍率) shows '－' on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=280A) and the kabutan margin-history page is behind a CAPTCHA. No options and no skew. Tape: 20d -4.67%, 5d -6.51%. The stock traded at 1,012-1,017 (-4.9%) intraday on 10-15 before the release. The 10-09 Entegris spike to 1,160 closed back at 1,061 and has fully faded. Market cap about 3.8bn yen; median turnover about 20m yen a day.

findings.finding: The revised FY guide implies H2 gross profit of only about 117m yen on 1,053m sales (11.1% margin, against H1's 15.4%: GP 326m on 2,126m) and an H2 operating loss of about 253m, more than ten times H1's -23.6m loss. If Q3 shows a cumulative operating loss well short of a pro-rata path toward -276m, the release can read as a held, conservative guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only up print in the baseline (+12.27%, Jan 2026) came with a raised or record guide. Prints that came with guide cuts or misses fell 7-22% (Apr 2026 -16.83% with the H1 guide; Jul 2026 -22.19%, limit down, on the FY cut).
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody covers the stock (kabuyoho consensus '--') and the implied H2 margin is not printed anywhere. It has to be derived from the guide's GP of 443m (supplementary p.5) less H1's GP of 326m (tanshin P/L). If the market had priced a conservative guide, the stock would not have kept sliding into the print (-6.5% over 5 days, -5% on the day) and would hold above the post-cut level of about 1,000. It sits at 1,012.
findings.independence: Shares the July documents with finding 3. The guide's own assumptions page (supplement p.49: equipment sales 1,958m against H1 equipment 1,665m and Q2-end backlog of 384m) shows H2 equipment sales of 293m sit below the backlog, which is the same conservative read.

findings.finding: The 2026-07-28 Kumamoto earthquake (max 震度7) halted JASM's Kikuyo fab, which restarted in stages from 2026-08-04 and was expected back at full output by mid-August, while Renesas's Kawashiri reported ceiling damage. TMH's Kyushu branch is in Kikuchi, next to these fabs. Restoration parts and repair demand in August falls inside Q3 (Jun-Aug).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this name. Parts/repair sales were 461m in H1 (-13% YoY), so this line has been weak.
findings.why_not_priced: The company's own notice (2026-07-30, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503427.pdf) called the impact 軽微 and said it was still checking customers' equipment, framing it as a risk rather than demand. The stock fell from 872 to 828 around the quake, so no upside is visibly held. This is a proxy: no company or counterparty number says the demand reached TMH.
findings.independence: EE Times Japan coverage of the fab shutdowns and restarts (https://eetimes.itmedia.co.jp/ee/articles/2607/28/news101.html) is a different outlet but reports the same event.

findings.finding: The revised guide still assumes parts/repair sales of 1,221m for FY2026 against H1's 461m (-13% YoY). That needs about 760m in H2, +65% on H1 and +11% on last year's H2 (685m). The line the company said 'did not keep pace with the boom' would have to reverse sharply, so a Q3 parts shortfall or a further FY trim is the main downside the release could add.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide misses and cuts on this name: Apr 2026 -16.83%, Jul 2026 -22.19% (limit down for two sessions, 1,803 to 1,103). Last year's Q3 (2025-10-14, a loss-making Jun-Aug quarter) drew -11.32%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: anyone can compute this from the July supplement (KPI p.14: H1 parts 461m vs 528m; assumptions p.49: parts 1,221m), and the stock already fell about 45% on the cut. What is not priced is a SECOND cut within the year, which the company's record makes plausible (the H1 forecast published in April missed by 10% on sales three months later). The stock trading near its post-cut level rather than below it says a second cut is not in the price.
findings.independence: Shares the July supplement with finding 1. The company's April H1 forecast (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260414503422.pdf), missed in July, is separate evidence that this guide-setter misses.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible, either way. The July guide looks conservative on margin and stretched on parts sales. The company already cut once this year and missed its April H1 forecast. No pre-release filed as of 10:13 JST. Shareholder returns: dividend is 0 and guided 0; no buyback or 優待 at the last two equivalent prints, so none expected. New-year guidance: not at a Q3 print. Quarter vs own 進捗率: not comparable, because FY2025 was equipment-driven (Q3 2025 alone was a loss) and FY2026 runs on the revised guide; the guide implies a Q3+Q4 operating loss of -253m.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +1.18, mostly squeeze arithmetic on a 1.28% single-seller short, which is thin fuel. The tape is weak (-6.5% over 5 days, -5% on the morning of the print), and the name sold 6 of its last 7 prints. My findings net to zero, so they neither confirm nor fight the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held guide with a Q3 cumulative loss well short of pace (finding 1, looked for). No dividend or buyback is plausible: dividend is 0, and the January buyback is done.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative built on a number anyone can compute from the last 短信): the parts-shortfall finding was cut from -2.0 to -1.5, and p_up moved from 46 to 48, because the H1 parts figure and the FY parts assumption are public in the July supplement. Only the risk of a second cut is left in it.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives): the strongest positive (a held guide with a Q3 cumulative loss short of pace) is written into baseline_tension and was looked for. The set stays one positive pair against one negative. No further change.
Positioning (open question 4, five-day run-in): recorded only. The -6.5% five-day decline was not sized as a finding.
